name: myagens-panel
comment:overrides: ejs only reaches this tree through workbox-build's service-worker builder, whose chain (rollup-plugin-off-main-thread -> ejs -> jake -> filelist -> minimatch) carries high-severity advisories with no fixed release upstream: workbox-build's latest IS the flagged version. ejs 6 dropped its jake dependency, so pinning it here removes the whole subtree. Must stay a top-level override, since npm 10 ignores a nested one whose path does not start at a root dependency.
